title: Minute Out In It: The Chase
licence: Public domain — work of the U.S. National Park Service (federal government). NPS media pages: items without a © symbol or non-NPS credit are public domain. Credit line recorded below.
contents: A lone black wolf tests a cow elk along Soda Butte Creek: the wolf stalks through grass, the elk bolts through the creek, splashing chase sequences back and forth (~70–135 s of source). Narration by Yellowstone Wolf Project research associate Kira Cassidy on the audio track.
